entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to start a return for a jersey I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
Got it, thank you. I see the order for the Pro-Line Aero Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's just the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a long ride and it's far too tight in the shoulders. I'd like to exchange it if possible.
I understand, getting the right fit is crucial. Thank you for clarifying. It looks like this jersey was delivered about 70 days ago. Let me just confirm our current policy for you.

Alright, I've checked and you're all set. Our standard items, like this jersey, have a 90-day return window. Since you're within that timeframe, I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Since I'm going through the hassle of packaging this up and sending it back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? To help cover the new purchase.

I'm happy we could get the return approved for you. While I can't offer a discount code for a sizing exchange, I can process this as a return for a full refund to your original payment method, or we can issue store credit you can use immediately toward the correct size.
I see. So no goodwill credit for the inconvenience of receiving a jersey that was too tight? Even 10% would make a difference.

I understand your position, but our policy on credits is reserved for issues like shipping errors or product defects. For a sizing preference, the approved solution is a straightforward exchange or refund. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. You can use that to send the item back at no cost to you.
Alright, fair enough. A full refund is what I needed most. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
